title: Refuse oversized and non-JSON request bodies properly
goal: Clients and proxies get the standard answers for bodies the API will not read, and the API reads less from abusive clients.

acceptance_criteria.text: A request body over 16 KB is refused with 413 and {"error": "request body too large"}; the limit is 16 KB, not 64 KB.

POST /todos and PATCH /todos/:id with a body need a Content-Type of application/json (parameters such as charset allowed, any case); otherwise they answer 415. A request without a body is judged as today.
Malformed JSON still answers 400. Existing clients that send application/json keep working; tests and scenarios are updated to send it.

context.notes: High risk: this changes what every client must send. Keep node:http only.
